cc:Work.dc:title: Sata 2010 Fe3C pressure-recalculation comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Original and derived pressure coordinates from the same nine measured sample/calibrant pairs. Printed Speziale BM3 coefficients; no Fe3C refit, source replacement or uncertainty inference.

g.text: Residuals against the unchanged published curve
Sata (2010) Fe₃C: published and recalculated pressure coordinates
Recalculated P: measured MgO V + printed Speziale BM3 (V₀=74.71 Å³, K₀=160.2 GPa, K₀′=3.99).
Derived coordinates, not established corrections. No new pressure-error bars or Fe₃C fit; Li points excluded from this comparison.
